provenance: Built renderer in isolated Electron; synthetic code/review bridge. No real main, PTY, Git command, or provider calls.
checks: Changes starts in a reading state without claiming non-repository
Unreadable Git response names the failure instead of no changes
A failed refresh keeps last known files visibly stale
Missing baseline is labeled as workspace changes
A slow changes read is not superseded by overlapping poll requests
A delayed read from an unmounted panel cannot replace current evidence
Remounted review follows recorded running status to completion
History refresh preserves the unsaved recipe
History errors retain evidence and recipe with a retry
